name: Infernal Pillar of Fire
body:
School conjuration [fire]; Level: alchemist 3, fire lord 2, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner 3, witch 3

Components: V, S, F (a small pillar of carved obsidian)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: Personal

Target(s): You

Duration: 2 rounds/level (D)

Saving Throw: Reflex half; Spell Resistance: yes

This spell is similar to levitate, except the caster levitates just above a 5 ft. wide pillar of fire. The caster may levitate to a maximum height of 20 ft. The pillar inflicts 2d6 damage to anything touching it or passing through it (Reflex save for half).
